# Strategy

What Quillmark is, what it makes and its parts are in [self.md](./self.md); this page says why it exists, who it serves and how it wins. Its outside is in [exterior.md](./exterior.md).

## Why it exists

Independent researchers lose their notes between tools. Quillmark keeps every note as plain text they own.

## How it wins

- Notes stay plain text, where Ledgerpad locks them in. Its page is ledgerpad.example.
- Sync runs on Acme Storage, so it must stay fast and cheap. Its page is acme.example.
- It follows the Open Notes Format.
- Moving notes between devices is a topic of its own.

## Words the project uses

Self, Exterior, Rivals, Vendors, Forces, Watch, What, Why, Who, It, Its, The, Their, In, This, One, Our, Read, And.
